card.name: Measurement nouns and angle wording
card.fires_on: Words that name a measured quantity or sit just before a number: volume, mm, km squared, interval, area. Also the article "a" or "an" in "at a 90° angle" for needle or syringe positioning.

modes.label: Measured quantity words
modes.description: A noun or unit naming something measured, such as semen volume, length in mm, area in km2, or PR interval.
